synopsis: Safe multi-task optimisation remains research rather than established heavy-machinery practice [f7034, f7342]. The glossary applies that research-status caveat specifically to transferring braking settings [f14454]. Chapter 9 cites work toward safe multi-task Bayesian optimisation presented by Lübsen, Hespe and Eichler at L4DC 2024, but does not establish readiness for heavy-machinery use [f7032, f7034].
